findings.reason: the measure passes on the weaker branch, so the section's own evidence (an empty pane across about 20 dispatches and many resumes) can be left unfixed by a node that meets its gate.
findings.text: §32's endpoint is an either/or: the mismatch either hands the follower to the caller's own host or merely prints a line and sets a JSON field, and the done-when accepts whichever the node chose, so the node can close having fixed only the silence while the reported symptom — the lead's monitor pane showing nothing for the session — remains

findings.reason: an unnamed record cannot be asserted by a test written from the plan, and a reviewer cannot check the dispatch document carries the fact at all.
findings.text: the deliverable requires "the dispatch JSON carries the same fact in a field" and the done-when asserts "the JSON field", but no field name or shape is given, so the test must either assert on a key it invents or assert nothing fixed
